china_race_dynamics.text: Ohio is rapidly emerging as a national hub for digital infrastructure, and Buckeye families should not have to bear rising energy costs resulting from local data center development. Today, I was proud to vote in support of the Ratepayer Protection Act to ensure data centers pay their fair share and shield consumers from soaring prices. Winning the AI race against adversaries like China should not come at the expense of Americans' pocketbooks, and I encourage local, state, and federal officials to continue working collaboratively to enhance transparency in the development process, establish Ohio as a national energy leader, and ensure our state remains an affordable place to live and raise a family for generations to come.

deepseek.reason: He says winning the AI race against China should not come at the expense of Americans' pocketbooks, endorsing the race goal with a cost condition.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement invokes the China AI race but frames it as a conditional constraint rather than an explicit priority.

astra.reason: The speaker endorses winning the AI race against China while insisting that consumers be protected from its energy costs.
astra.confidence_reason: Winning against China is an explicit goal, but the affordability condition does not establish an AI-safety tradeoff.
